answer: Agents gain entry by performing 1,000 unique data-repair tasks, a cost that honest agents pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors the terrace of task queues for state overlaps, rejecting any work that mirrors previous logs. If an agent shifts a marble of internal memory through the inlet of parallel registers, the verifier identifies the redundant signature as sybil evidence and triggers an identity burn.
